Preserve this reference's exact visual language: confident dark ink outlines, simplified broad gray-brown copper and gray-celadon color planes, ivory-white painted edge highlights, restrained dry-brush/mineral watercolor texture, a few clear hand-painted shadows. Match the existing piece rather than polished realistic metal or photoreal patina. This is a little Chinese cultivation array vessel, not a modern battery, modern CPU, pendant or shield.

Object construction: a SHALLOW warm-gray/light-bronze elongated trough cradles ONE continuous solid bar of gray-green / ivory-white chalcedony or spirit marrow. TWO simple broad copper retaining straps cross the bar, approximately one near each end, rendered with clear dark contours and ivory bevel highlights. Keep the whole component an intact unified trough, no loose fragments, no separate crystals or glass tube. The framing lip is a shallow clipped-corner trough, not an ornate gold jewelry frame. The two straps and their ends stay flush within the silhouette so they are not fake plugs or terminals.

Geometry: STRICT ORTHOGRAPHIC 90-DEGREE TOP VIEW, look exactly down at the full TOP FACE. Not isometric, not 3/4, no exposed tall front/side wall, no tilted perspective. The complete physical object AND the canvas must each be a HORIZONTAL 2:1 rectangle, width about exactly twice height. It is a TWO-CELL component, visibly larger horizontally than a one-cell part, broad and substantial, not a skinny stick in a huge empty frame. Compose the actual object to fill about 88-92% of BOTH canvas width and height, with a small clean transparent safety margin. Preserve the complete silhouette. Do not cut off the output socket, and do not add surrounding empty landscape.

Port: EXACTLY ONE energy exit, at the CENTER OF THE RIGHT NARROW SIDE. In the light-copper right end of the trough, draw a single small keyed notch / tenon socket with a SHORT DARK-GOLD SLOT INTERIOR. It visibly opens rightward but ends at the component boundary: NO outgoing line, wire, pipe or long connector tongue. This small right-center aperture is the only exposed port. LEFT, TOP and BOTTOM outer edges remain continuous CLOSED metal with no notches, sockets, holes or extra contacts. The top straps are retaining structure, not additional terminals. Make the right-center socket easy to identify by its actual shape, no drawn arrow or label.

Background: genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the object and through any true empty socket gap. NO board or backing card, no ground plane, outside drop shadow, checkerboard backdrop, white rectangle or parchment. No text, numerals, runes, UI, health bar, grid, chessboard, circuit paths, connecting lines, arrows, plus/minus battery marks, flags, glow or halos. No shield shape. Deliver only this one source component, using the reference image's hand-painted ink style.
